description: Add (or subtract, with negative numbers) years, months, weeks, days, hours and minutes to a date, or add business days (skipping Saturdays and Sundays). Month ends are clamped (31 Jan + 1 month = 28/29 Feb). Use to compute due dates and expiries. Example: date=2026-01-31, months=1, days=0, businessDays=0. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.
